verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any built-in Aircall analytics or reporting showing call volume, answer rate, or missed calls per number and per teammate. The only related item is a developer tutorial for building a custom Activity Tracker on the Public API. That is a building block a developer would assemble, not the product's own reporting capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can see call volume, answer rate, and missed calls per number and per teammate

citations.quote: Build a custom Activity Tracker to monitor and summarize Aircall user availabilities, call activities, and KPIs from a single view.
